race.comment: ED I AM (14) has the right profile to take beating after a strong campaign that includes two wins and a fifth in Saturday company at Eagle Farm. The class relief, weight relief and solid Gold Coast Poly trial since all support the case, while his three wins have all come over this trip. SENESCHAL (8) looks the main danger after being beaten just over half a length in a CL4 at the Sunny Coast despite blundering at the start and racing wide throughout. He's proven at the trip and has enough substance to turn that narrow defeat around. ITALIAN DANCER (2) brings winning form from the Poly and then led until late when fourth at Eagle Farm, with Tierney's outstanding record aboard him a major plus. FLYING BAT (6) is honest and on a suitable quick back-up, though he must reverse the recent Poly result with ITALIAN DANCER.
